Question: A palindrome is a nonnegative integer number that reads the same forwards and backwards when written in base \(10\) with no leading zeros. A \(6\)-digit palindrome \(n\) is chosen uniformly at random. What is the probability that \(\dfrac{n}{11}\) is also a palindrome?
